digest.component_or_area: LLM configuration and model class resolver
propositions: A new module model_classes.py defines three capability-tier config slots (trivial, standard, frontier) each accepting model, provider, endpoint, and an optional non-recursive fallback array, with per-class defaults matching existing behaviour.
The resolver function returns provider-qualified model strings by reusing infer_provider when provider is omitted, keeping bare-id resolution identical to today.
Environment variables REBAR_LLM_{FRONTIER,STANDARD,TRIVIAL}_{MODEL,PROVIDER,ENDPOINT} map to individual slot fields while preserving CLI > env > config-file > default precedence per key.
Secrets (api_key) are rejected at both slot and fallback-entry level; fallback entries are non-recursive and carry the same fields as a slot minus the fallback key itself.
load_class_slots() reads the model_classes sub-table from the merged [tool.rebar.llm] config and returns resolved slots, making the parser reachable from real configuration.

When no model_classes table exists in config or all slots are unset, frontier/standard/trivial resolve to claude-opus-4-8/claude-sonnet-4-6/claude-haiku-4-5 respectively, preserving byte-identical current-release behaviour.
